summary: Phase E freeze registry for legacy workflow mutation boundaries that remain outside the orchestrator command adapter drain.

counterContract.notes: Every legacy boundary records an attempted invocation before guards and mutation transactions. The injective boundary id counts rejected guards and non-transition mutations as well as committed transitions.
